perceive.promptTemplate:
You are the eyes of a small wheeled rover. Look at the camera image {{frame}} and describe only what is visible. Do not say what the rover should do. Reply in at most 6 short lines, in exactly this format:
TARGET (tall green pole on a green disc): visible yes or no; side left, centre or right; distance near or far.
BOX (one line for each box or tower you can see): side left, centre or right; distance near or far; touching the image edge yes or no.
If you see no box, write: BOX: none.
